descriptionChirho: General work, labor, or task — the common sense covering construction projects, agricultural effort, ritual service, and any productive activity.
Skilled craft or artisanship — the quality or product of skilled manual work, as in the construction of the tabernacle or an artisan's trade.
Commercial activity or regular occupation — a person's trade, errand, or affair requiring attention.
Material possessions or goods — movable property or belongings, especially as objects of value or wealth.
Livestock or cattle — a concrete extension of 'property' referring specifically to domestic animals as possessions.
